description:
Move event matching in the integration suites onto the body view.

## Background

Integration tests match `Event::<Variant>` in `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs` (7 lines), `fast_issue/lifecycle_timestamps_tests.rs` (6), `cli_repo_workflow/linked_checkout_write_policy_tests.rs` (4), `scratch_build/repository_state_cutover_tests.rs` (4) and six further files in the footprint; some build variants with explicit `id` and `timestamp` fields. `jit::test_utils` offers a helper that stamps an id and a timestamp onto a body.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No integration-test pattern under `crates/jit/tests` matches `Event::<Variant>`; each matches `EventBody::<Variant>` on the body view.
- [hard] REQ-02: In integration tests, no pattern binds `id` or `timestamp` from a variant, and no code outside `domain/types.rs` constructs a variant with those fields; constructions use draft constructors or the `test_utils` helper that stamps both.
- [hard] REQ-03: Test assertions are otherwise unchanged.
title: Integration tests match events through the body view
